title: tribulus terrestris var. rajasthanensis
intro: Tribulus terrestris var. rajasthanensis, commonly known as the 'Rajasthan Tribulus', is a subspecies of the Tribulus terrestris plant, a type of flowering plant in the family Zygophyllaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including improved cardiovascular health, enhanced libido, and potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tribulus terrestris var. rajasthanensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, such as tribuloside, tribulusterine, and ursolic acid. These bioactive compounds are believed to contribute to the plant's therapeutic effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine and supplements.
